verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same failed banner. The purple circle shrinks to a meaningless clipped wedge stuck on the left, and the robot vacuum is cropped and darkened until you can't tell what the product is. The dot grid floats as filler and the right side is crammed with type while the middle sits empty. A groups 'Smart Home' tightly with GADGETS as one unit. B leaves a wide gap that splits the headline into two fragments, so A is slightly better.
